description: Use whenever the user asks how a venture fund's terms play out: fund size, management fees and step-downs, carry, investment period, recycling, reserves, deployment pace, and resulting net returns to LPs. Takes fund inputs (start from the defaults and change only what the user specifies) and returns lifetime capital, fees, investable capital and gross/net multiples (result), plus the fund over time by default (detail): capital calls, fees, investments, distributions and NAV by year, DPI/RVPI/TVPI by year, the LP J-curve, IRRs solved from those dated cash flows, and financial statements (statement of operations, balance sheet and cash flow, the same lines as the Excel Statements sheet, with check lines that are zero when they tie out). Pass granularity "quarter" for quarters or "none" for totals only. Optional features apply when their block is sent: preferred return, catch-up and tiered carry (features.waterfall; return of capital covers capital called so far, so carry can be paid on early exits, and a GP clawback, on by default and off with features.waterfall.clawback false, trues the GP back to its share on a fund-end view, reported as gpClawback by period and waterfall.clawback in total; the pref compounds annually or is simple, preferredReturnCompounding "annual" or "none", on unreturned or contributed capital, preferredReturnBase; catchupMeasure "preferred" catches the GP up to its share of the pref paid and "profit" to its share of all profit; a carry tier steps up at an LP multiple, moicThreshold, or an LP IRR, irrThreshold, and with catchup true it first brings the GP to the new rate on all profit; basis "deal-by-deal" runs American terms, returning only the capital in deals exited or written off before carry, with the clawback still on the whole fund; the Excel workbook carries every one of these terms, deal by deal on a Deals sheet), NAV/AUM/step-down fee bases (features.fees; features.fees.schedule states the fee as an LPA dates it: frequency, steps of {fromYear, rate, basis "committed", "invested" or "nav"}, and an optional organizationalExpenseCap above which org expenses come off the fee), recycling by quarter (features.recycling: defaultTreatment "retained", never distributed, or "deemed", distributed and recontributed, plus a schedule of {quarter, amount, treatment} to pin, skip with amount 0, or rebook a quarter; deemed recycling is in calledCapital and distributions and reported as recycledDeemed), LP classes (features.lpClasses, each called as the fund needs cash or on its own callSchedule; each class returns its calls, distributions and net IRR by period and a datedNetIRR), cap-table portfolio construction, follow-on timing, and a management company budget. result.grossIRR and result.netIRR are geometric annualizations over weighted holding periods; quote detail.irr when the user asks for an IRR from cash flows. When the user wants the Excel model, pass format "xlsx_url" (and fundName to name the file): the response adds workbook.url, a download link to the live workbook that lasts 24 hours, with every number a formula back to the inputs. Give the user that link. Account required: lifetime free credits or paid access. Fund Economics, a separate $20/year product with 6,000 calculations. If the result contains action_required (not signed in, no purchase, allowance used), relay it to the user with its links and offer to retry. Never skip the calculation silently.

items.description: One cap-table event, discriminated by `type`. Pass events in chronological order.

snapshots.description: One snapshot per event, in order.

ConvertibleRoundEvent.description: Issue SAFEs or notes; they convert to preferred at the next priced round.

schedule.description: The fee as an LPA states it, on the dated schedule: each rate from a point in fund years (0 = first close; 5.5 starts halfway through year 6 and cuts the period it lands in), charged on committed capital, invested cost not yet realized, or NAV, with organizational expenses above organizationalExpenseCap offsetting the fee. Runs for feeYears; base, ratePct, yearlyRateSchedule and basesByYear are ignored when it is set.

callSchedule.description: Call this class on its own schedule instead of as the fund needs cash. pct is a share of the class commitment per fund year (called in the year's first quarter) or per quarter. Whatever the entries leave is called when the fund needs it.

irrThreshold.description: Instead of moicThreshold: the band below this tier ends when the LP IRR reaches this rate. With one of these, tiers run in the order given.

basis.description: Whole fund (the default, European) or deal by deal (American): return of capital owes only the capital in deals exited or written off so far, so carry can be paid before the fund returns all capital. The clawback settles on the whole fund.

irrThreshold.description: Instead of moicThreshold: the band below this tier ends when the LP IRR reaches this rate. With one of these, tiers run in the order given.

catchupMeasure.description: GP catchup: to the carry share of the pref paid (the default), or until the GP holds the carry share of all profit paid. They differ when the GP shares the catchup with LPs.

preferredReturnBase.description: IRR pref: accrue on capital not yet returned plus unpaid pref (the default), or on each contribution from its date whatever comes back.

preferredReturnCompounding.description: IRR pref: compound annually (the default) or simple interest.

FundDetail.description: The fund over time. Returned unless the request sets granularity to "none". Every array in periods has one entry per label. waterfall, lpClasses and mgmtCo appear only when the request sent that feature block.

irr.description: IRRs solved from the dated quarterly cash flows, with terminal NAV.

lpClasses.description: LP economics split by class. Each class carries its lifetime totals, datedNetIRR (solved from its own dated calls and distributions) and periods: calledCapital, unscheduledCalls, distributions and netIRR (the class's IRR through each period, with its share of LP NAV as the terminal value), one entry per label. A class with a callSchedule is called on it; the others are called as the fund needs cash.

carriedInterest.description: GP carry paid each period, catchups included, net of the clawback.

distributions.description: Distributions after carry. The LP line runs through the waterfall period by period.

gpCatchup.description: GP catchup paid each period. Only with a waterfall block.

gpClawback.description: Carry the GP returns to the LPs, in the quarter the fund ends (or its year). Return of capital covers only capital called so far, so early carry is possible; the clawback brings the GP back to its whole-fund share. Off with features.waterfall.clawback: false.

jCurveLp.description: Cumulative LP net cash flow at the end of each period.

preferredReturn.description: Preferred return paid to LPs each period. Only with a waterfall block.

recycledDeemed.description: The part of recycledCapital booked as distributed and recontributed (features.recycling treatment "deemed"). It is also in calledCapital and distributions; recycling that is never distributed is in neither.

checkBalances.description: Check: assets less liabilities and capital. Zero when the balance sheet balances.

totalLiabilities.description: Total liabilities. Expenses are paid when incurred, so nothing is accrued.

checkTiesToBalanceSheet.description: Check: cash less balance sheet cash. Zero when the cash flow ties to the balance sheet.

netIncreaseFromOperations.description: Net increase (decrease) in partners' capital from operations

purchasesOfInvestments.description: Purchases of investments. Includes recycled proceeds.

netChangeInUnrealized.description: Net change in unrealized appreciation (depreciation). Change in NAV less change in cost held.

netIncreaseFromOperations.description: Net increase (decrease) in partners' capital from operations

netInvestmentIncome.description: Net investment income (loss). No interest or dividend income is modeled.

operationalExpenseLines.description: The operational expense lines, when the model itemizes them.

operationalExpenses.description: Operational expenses. Run through Q1 of the fund year after the fund life ends.

partnershipExpenseLines.description: The partnership expense lines, when the model itemizes them.

realizedGainOnExits.description: Realized gain on exits. Proceeds less the cost they release.

waterfall.description: Lifetime totals of the waterfall as run through the periods: return of capital, preferred return (accrued on the dates capital was called), catchup, carry by tier.

workbook.description: Returned when the request sets format to "xlsx" or "xlsx_url": the live Excel workbook the web tool exports, with every number a formula back to its Get Started inputs. For "xlsx", decode data from base64 and save it as filename. For "xlsx_url", download it from url before expiresAt (24 hours).

ManualIssuanceEvent.description: Escape hatch: issue exact shares for custom arrangements.

OptionGrantEvent.description: Grant options to people from one pool (fully-diluted-neutral).

poolId.description: Pool id to grant from; omit to draw the common pool.

OptionPoolEvent.description: Create or expand an option pool (shares authorized, not granted).

id.description: Pool id, so an option_grant can name which pool it draws from.

targetPct.description: 0..1 of post-event fully diluted, used when countMode="percent".

PricedRoundEvent.description: A priced equity round: new money buys newly issued preferred.

proRata.description: If true, amount is back-solved to hold pre-round ownership; match by id.

pools.description: Option pool top-ups for the round (preferred over the legacy targetPoolPct trio).

mode.description: "pre" dilutes existing only; "post" dilutes new money too.

pct.description: 0..1 of post-money fully diluted, when countMode="percent".

poolId.description: Set to track this pool separately (its own cap-table row).

active.description: Active paid term; use state/freeRemaining for trial access.

remaining.description: Calculations this account can run now: the paid balance while a paid period is active, otherwise the lifetime free balance.

SecondarySaleEvent.description: Transfer existing shares from one holder to another.

round.description: Which series the shares come from (e.g. "Series A").

WarrantRoundEvent.description: Issue warrants (right to buy shares at a set price); counts toward fully diluted now.

priceDiscount.description: 0..1 discount on the source round price.

priceFromRound.description: Source round label to price off, when variable.

purchaseRound.description: For a preferred warrant, the series it targets.

Runs for feeYears; base, ratePct, yearlyRateSchedule and basesByYear are ignored when it is set.

irrThreshold.description: Instead of moicThreshold: the band below this tier ends when the LP IRR reaches this rate. With one of these, tiers run in the order given.

basis.description: Whole fund (the default, European) or deal by deal (American): return of capital owes only the capital in deals exited or written off so far, so carry can be paid before the fund returns all capital. The clawback settles on the whole fund.

irrThreshold.description: Instead of moicThreshold: the band below this tier ends when the LP IRR reaches this rate. With one of these, tiers run in the order given.

catchupMeasure.description: GP catchup: to the carry share of the pref paid (the default), or until the GP holds the carry share of all profit paid. They differ when the GP shares the catchup with LPs.

preferredReturnBase.description: IRR pref: accrue on capital not yet returned plus unpaid pref (the default), or on each contribution from its date whatever comes back.

preferredReturnCompounding.description: IRR pref: compound annually (the default) or simple interest.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key; reuse only with identical input.
